description: This file implements a memory debugging utility for JSON memory allocations, including tracking, reporting, and optional backtrace tracing, specifically for use with the Jansson JSON library.
external_methods: ds_tree.h: ds_tree_find, ds_tree_node_insert, ds_tree_remove, ds_tree_foreach, DS_TREE_INIT

methods.name: json_memdbg_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with tracking and optional backtrace capture for debugging.

methods.name: json_memdbg_free
methods.description: Frees tracked memory, verifying magic number and updating statistics.

methods.name: json_memdbg_get_stats
methods.description: Retrieves current total allocated memory and count of allocations.

methods.name: json_memdbg_report
methods.description: Logs current memory usage statistics, optionally only if changed.

methods.name: json_memdbg_do_report
methods.description: Timer callback to trigger memory report.

methods.name: json_memdbg_init
methods.description: Initializes the memory debugging system, setting custom allocators and starting report timer if applicable.
